<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Mark onboarding complete so Live Preview skips the wizard.
update_option(
	'handl_aicac_onboard',
	array(
		'status'        => 'complete',
		'eligible'      => true,
		'step'          => 4,
		'mode'          => 'observe',
		'observe_days'  => 14,
		'review_due_ts' => 0,
		'leads_consent' => false,
		'scan_status'   => 'skipped',
	),
	false
);

// Enable Activity logging (direct option write — avoids save_policy side effects).
$policy = get_option( 'handl_aicac_policy', array() );
if ( ! is_array( $policy ) ) {
	$policy = array();
}
$policy['log_enabled'] = true;
update_option( 'handl_aicac_policy', $policy, false );

// Seed labeled demo Activity rows via the plugin API when available.
if ( class_exists( '\HandL\AICAC\Demo_Mode' ) ) {
	\HandL\AICAC\Demo_Mode::seed();
}
